name: agentflow
description: Local-first multi-agent coding orchestration desktop app

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n UI,SIDECAR -c blue,green "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:sidecar"
scripts.dev:tauri: npm run build:ui && npm run build:sidecar && tauri dev --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.build:tauri: npm run build && tauri build --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:ui && npm run build:sidecar
scripts.build:sidecar: tsc -p apps/runtime/tsconfig.json && esbuild apps/runtime/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=apps/runtime/dist/main.js && node scripts/copy-node-runtime.mjs
scripts.typecheck:ui: tsc --noEmit --jsx react-jsx --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM apps/ui/src/AgentFlowWorkspace.tsx
